Biography

ZUBEK is a Cleveland-based commercial video production company specializing in branded content, music videos, and documentary work — with FAA Part 107 aerial coverage built into every shoot, and photography on request. Founded and directed by Owen Zubek, whose credits include Machine Gun Kelly, Denzel Ward, and Lululemon, the studio stays small and senior: the same person who pitches the treatment shoots and edits it.
